verdict.rationale: GA4 exposes a broad first-party API surface. The Data API covers standard, pivot, realtime and funnel reports, and its data is documented as consistent with the UI. The Admin API handles account creation, custom dimensions and metrics, key events, data retention, Measurement Protocol secrets, change history and product links, and is complemented by the Measurement Protocol, User Deletion API and BigQuery raw export. However, nothing claims full UI parity, and several pieces (bigQueryLinks, tag snippet generation, funnel and realtime features) are alpha or beta. Missing for 10: an explicit UI-parity guarantee, evidence of API coverage for UI features such as Explorations, audiences and report customization, GA (non-alpha/beta) status for all config endpoints, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
